changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The submitted content of a team item version, one row for each member of the version (ADR 0165). Nothing writes it yet.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE public.team_snapshot ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_key CHECK (snapshot_key ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_role CHECK (role IN ('MAIN', 'SUPPORTING')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_entry_route CHECK (entry_route IN ('PLUGIN_CAPTURE', 'EDITOR_CAPTURE', 'LINK_IMPORT', 'FILE_UPLOAD', 'PINNED_COMMIT')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_source_how CHECK (source_how IN ('MEMBER_SUPPLIED', 'READ_AS_MEMBER')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_normalized_by CHECK (normalized_by IN ('SERVER', 'CLIENT')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_normalizer CHECK ((normalized_by IS NULL) = (normalizer_id IS NULL) AND (normalizer_id IS NULL) = (normalizer_version IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_normalized CHECK ( (normalized IS NOT NULL) = (normalized_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SERVER') AND (normalized IS NULL) = (normalized_sha256 IS NULL) AND (normalized IS NULL OR normalized_sha256 = encode(sha256(normalized), 'hex'))), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_content CHECK (content_sha256 = encode(sha256(content), 'hex')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_size CHECK (octet_length(content) <= 10485760 AND coalesce(octet_length(normalized), 0) <= 2097152 AND coalesce(octet_length(preview), 0) <= 4194304), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_source_revision CHECK (source_revision IS NULL OR (source_how = 'READ_AS_MEMBER' AND jsonb_typeof(source_revision) = 'object')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_live_link CHECK (live_link IS NULL OR (live_link LIKE 'https://%' AND char_length(live_link) <= 2048)), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_team_snapshot_limitations CHECK (jsonb_typeof(limitations) = 'array');

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The rules of a snapshot, for every writer. Content arrives only with its version, never changes, and only its live link can be removed.
changeSet.createProcedure: CREATE FUNCTION public.guard_team_snapshot() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF ROW(NEW.id, NEW.workspace_id, NEW.version_id, NEW.snapshot_key, NEW.role, NEW.entry_route, NEW.content, NEW.media_type, NEW.content_sha256, NEW.normalized, NEW.normalized_sha256, NEW.normalizer_id, NEW.normalizer_version, NEW.normalized_by, NEW.preview, NEW.source_how, NEW.source_revision, NEW.limitations) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id, OLD.workspace_id, OLD.version_id, OLD.snapshot_key, OLD.role, OLD.entry_route, OLD.content, OLD.media_type, OLD.content_sha256, OLD.normalized, OLD.normalized_sha256, OLD.normalizer_id, OLD.normalizer_version, OLD.normalized_by, OLD.preview, OLD.source_how, OLD.source_revision, OLD.limitations) OR (NEW.live_link IS NOT NULL AND NEW.live_link IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.live_link) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'a snapshot never changes; only its live link can be removed' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF; RETURN NULL; END $$

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A version that ends, by any writer, loses its content in the same transaction.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER team_item_version_content AFTER UPDATE OF state ON public.team_item_version FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.state != 'AVAILABLE') EXECUTE FUNCTION public.delete_ended_team_version_content();
